name: Inigo Mato Ruiz
bio: Inigo is from Madrid where he works as iOS Agile Lead at Kindred Group, developing gambling apps. He graduated in Electronics Engineering but soon realised he preferred software development over hardware design. His software developing journey has taken him to places such as a California based start-up or an Oxford University spin-off. In his spare time he plays table tennis and board games and enjoys making prank apps with friends.
